{"message":"It sounds like a redirect‑URL mismatch, which is the most common cause of the loop you’re seeing. Meridian expects the IdP’s assertion to be posted back to the exact callback URL shown in **Settings → Security → SSO → Configuration**. That URL must match character‑for‑character what you’ve entered as the reply/redirect URI on the IdP side – even a trailing slash or an http/https difference will cause the sign‑in to bounce back to the login page.

**What to do:**
1. Open the SSO configuration page in Meridian and copy the callback URL.
2. In your IdP console, locate the application’s reply URL (or redirect URI) and compare it to the callback URL you just copied.
3. If there’s any mismatch, edit the IdP setting to match exactly, then re‑save the application (some IdPs cache the old value until you re‑save).

After the URLs match, try signing in again – the loop should be resolved."}

arguments.message:
It sounds like a redirect‑URL mismatch, which is the most common cause of the loop you’re seeing. Meridian expects the IdP’s assertion to be posted back to the exact callback URL shown in **Settings → Security → SSO → Configuration**. That URL must match character‑for‑character what you’ve entered as the reply/redirect URI on the IdP side – even a trailing slash or an http/https difference will cause the sign‑in to bounce back to the login page.

**What to do:**
1. Open the SSO configuration page in Meridian and copy the callback URL.
2. In your IdP console, locate the application’s reply URL (or redirect URI) and compare it to the callback URL you just copied.
3. If there’s any mismatch, edit the IdP setting to match exactly, then re‑save the application (some IdPs cache the old value until you re‑save).

After the URLs match, try signing in again – the loop should be resolved.
